// diagnostic E2724

Jet.GrammarFieldShape

This grammar rule's generated type does not hold together

What

This grammar rule's generated type does not hold together

Why

Each parser rule becomes a type, so its labels and alternatives must give every field one name and one type, and every case its own name.

Fix

Label the elements and alternatives so that each field and case has one name and one type.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.GrammarFieldShape: Tests/UI/grammar_field_shape.stderr.

Error: Jet.GrammarFieldShape: The rule `item` appears twice in this alternative without labels
  --> Tests/UI/grammar_field_shape.jet:6:21
    |
  6 |     pair : item '=' item ;
    |                     ^
 Why: Each parser rule becomes a type, so its labels and alternatives must give every field one name and one type, and every case its own name
 Fix: Label each use, as `left=item … right=item`
